verdict.rationale: Navan's pricing page lists 'Receipt scanning for on-the-go expenses', which is first-party evidence that it captures receipts from photos. The API overview also mentions receipts. Beyond that one thin mention, the evidence says nothing about how scanning works or what happens after capture. Missing for 10: email-forwarding capture, documented OCR extraction of receipt fields, automatic matching of receipts to card transactions, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an employee, I can snap a photo or forward an email and the platform OCRs the receipt and files it against the right transaction
